data.title: WXSS
data.tagline: A style language that describes the appearance and layout of WeChat mini program components
data.learningOutcome: Choose styles for an appearance change and separately verify the button’s behavior.
data.description: A booking button can keep the same label and action while its color, corners, and spacing change through WXSS. It controls appearance; it does not submit or save bookings.

learning.assumes: You have adjusted a page’s colors or spacing.
learning.outcome: Choose styles for an appearance change and separately verify the button’s behavior.

distinctions.label: WXML
distinctions.explanation: Declares which components exist. WXSS styles those components.

distinctions.label: CSS
distinctions.explanation: WXSS borrows many CSS conventions and adds units such as rpx. Platform support must be checked rather than assuming full browser compatibility.

explanation.title: A class connects component and style
explanation.text: class="reserve" connects the WXML button to .reserve in WXSS. The same class can style several matching objects.

explanation.title: Styles have a scope
explanation.text: app.wxss provides app-wide page styles; the page’s WXSS styles that page. Custom components may isolate their styles.

data.boundary: A color change cannot fix a failed save. Check component style isolation and platform support when a selector does not apply; do not assume all browser CSS behaves identically.

lessonPractice.title: The booking button saves correctly. Only its background and corners need changing. Which file is responsible?

options.label: Change the matching styles in WXSS
options.feedback: This is an appearance change; retain and verify the existing action.

options.label: Rebuild the button structure in WXML
options.feedback: Structure is already present; rebuilding it is unnecessary for these style properties.

options.label: Change the booking save handler in JavaScript
options.feedback: The save handler is already working and does not own these static styles.

data.agentPrompt: Style the booking button in this WeChat page’s WXSS using the project theme color and existing corner and spacing rules. Keep its label, placement, and click handler. Check narrow and wide screens and complete a booking to verify the behavior.
